fields.title: PACRA registry search result
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, _matchCount on successful searches). One record per matching entity found for a query; a search with zero matches emits one summary record with _matchCount: 0 and no entity fields (a valid outcome, not an error). Entity fields (entityID, entityName, ...) are passed through verbatim from PACRA's own registrysearch API.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact search query string that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-registrysearch-api, or "none" on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_matchCount.title: Match count
_matchCount.description: Total number of entities the query matched (present on successful searches, including zero-match ones -- capped at 50 by the upstream API, which exposes no pagination parameter).

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed searches -- the error kind (http_<code>, invalid_json, unexpected_shape, blocked_or_transient, empty_query).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

entityID.title: Entity ID
entityID.description: PACRA's internal GUID for this entity (used as the identifier when previewing/printing a certificate on portal.pacra.org.zm -- not the public registration number).

entityTypeId.title: Entity type ID
entityTypeId.description: Raw upstream entity type code: 1 = Local Company, 2 = Business Name, 4 = Foreign Company (per the site's own frontend; type 3 was never observed live).

entityTypeLabel.title: Entity type
entityTypeLabel.description: Human-readable label derived from entityTypeId by this actor (not an upstream field) -- "Local Company", "Business Name", "Foreign Company", or "Unknown Type <id>".

entityNumber.title: Registration number
entityNumber.description: PACRA registration/incorporation number. Note: searching BY this number does not reliably return the entity (see README known limits) -- this field is only useful as an output/lookup key, not a working search input.

registrationDate.title: Registration date
registrationDate.description: Date the entity was registered/incorporated, as returned by PACRA (dd/mm/yyyy string, passed through unparsed).

companyType.title: Company type
companyType.description: Upstream legal-form description, e.g. "Local Company - Limited by Shares", "Business Name - Individual/Partnership".

entityLimit.title: Entity limit
entityLimit.description: Upstream classification of company limitation, e.g. "Ordinary Company" (blank for business names).

natureofBusiness.title: Nature of business
natureofBusiness.description: Free-text description of the entity's business activity, when PACRA has one on file (often blank).

isicClasification.title: ISIC classification
isicClasification.description: International Standard Industrial Classification code + short label, e.g. "6419. Other monetary intermediation" (often blank).

isicDescription.title: ISIC description
isicDescription.description: Full ISIC classification description text (often blank).

annualReturnStatus.title: Annual return status
annualReturnStatus.description: Upstream compliance flag for annual return filing (0/1).

annualReturnReason.title: Annual return reason
annualReturnReason.description: Human-readable explanation of the annual return compliance status, including the last-filed date where applicable.

nominalCapitalStatus.title: Nominal capital status
nominalCapitalStatus.description: Upstream compliance flag for nominal capital (0/1).

nominalCapitalReason.title: Nominal capital reason
nominalCapitalReason.description: Human-readable explanation of the nominal capital compliance status.

parValueStatus.title: Par value status
parValueStatus.description: Upstream compliance flag for share par value (upstream sends this as a string "0"/"1", unlike the other *Status flags which are integers -- passed through as-is).

parValueReason.title: Par value reason
parValueReason.description: Human-readable explanation of the par value compliance status.

beneficialOwnerStatus.title: Beneficial owner status
beneficialOwnerStatus.description: Upstream compliance flag for beneficial-ownership disclosure (0/1).

beneficialOwnerReason.title: Beneficial owner reason
beneficialOwnerReason.description: Human-readable explanation of the beneficial-ownership compliance status.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for a PACRA registry search result.
